purpose: This eye drop is used to treat a condition called Demodex blepharitis, which is an eyelid infection caused by tiny mites that live at the base of your eyelashes. These mites can cause your eyelids to feel itchy, crusty, irritated, and inflamed. This medication helps get rid of those mites so your eyes and eyelids can feel better.
how_it_works: Lotilaner works by targeting the nervous system of the tiny Demodex mites living on your eyelashes and eyelids. It essentially paralyzes and kills the mites, stopping them from causing further irritation. Over time, as the mites are eliminated, your eyelid symptoms improve.
common_side_effects: The most common side effect is a brief stinging or burning feeling in the eye right after putting in the drops. Some people also notice mild eye irritation or discomfort. These effects are usually short-lived and go away quickly.
warnings: Tell your doctor if you wear contact lenses, as you should remove them before using the drops and wait at least 15 minutes before putting them back in. Let your doctor know if you have any eye infections or other eye conditions before starting this medication. Avoid letting the tip of the dropper touch your eye or any other surface to keep it clean and germ-free.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is one drop in each affected eye twice a day, about 12 hours apart, for 6 weeks. Try to use it at the same times each day, such as morning and evening, to get the best results. Always follow the exact instructions your doctor gives you.
